description: Lists the cap tables, exit waterfalls and fund models saved to the user's Hemrock account, plus fund models others have shared with them, newest first. Each has its kind, id, name, the user's role (owner, editor, viewer) and a url that opens it in the browser builder. Call this when the user mentions "my cap table", "my fund model" or a model by name, before building one from scratch. Free: uses no calculations. Needs a signed-in connection.

kind.description: "cap-table" (Cap Table builder), "waterfall" (Exit Waterfall builder) or "fund" (the web Venture Capital Model).

name: list_saved_models
title: List saved models
